noNetwork.title: No network is set up
noNetwork.body: This copy of the page has no deployment to read. Deploy the contracts, then rebuild the page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.heading: There is nothing at this address
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. The ballots are all in one list.

footer.note: Every number on these pages is read from this ledger, not reported by a server.

pending.next: Created when an officer opens it

closed.current: Waiting for someone to count the votes

finalised.next: Published once the votes are counted

ballots.title: Ballots
ballots.lede: Every question the society has put to its members. The counts are read from the ledger.

empty.title: No ballots yet
empty.body: When an officer opens a ballot, it appears here.

error.title: Could not read the ballots
error.body: {network} did not answer. Your connection may be down, or the network may be.

ballots.stale: Showing what was read last. The network did not answer just now.

error.title: Could not read this ballot
error.body: {network} did not answer. Try again in a moment.

turnout.title: Turnout
turnout.summary: {votes} of {electorate} members have voted. {needed} are needed for the result to count.
turnout.summaryReached: {votes} of {electorate} members have voted. The {needed} needed for the result to count have been reached.

outcome.counting: Voting has ended. The result is not final until someone counts the votes.
outcome.carriedDetail: {votes} of {electorate} members voted, which met the quorum of {needed}.
outcome.advisoryDetail: Only {votes} of {electorate} members voted and {needed} were needed, so this result is advisory and does not bind the society.
outcome.tiedDetail: {options} each received {count} votes. The society's own rules decide what happens next.
outcome.noVotesDetail: No votes were cast on this ballot, so it has no result.
outcome.withdrawn: This ballot was withdrawn before voting opened.

rules.title: How this ballot is decided
rules.electorateHelp: Counted when the ballot was created, so adding members later cannot move the bar.
rules.quorumValue: {percent} percent of the members, which is {needed} votes
rules.methodValue: The option with the most votes wins. If two options tie, nothing carries.

vote.title: Your vote
vote.review: You are voting for {option} as {who}. A vote cannot be changed once it is recorded.
vote.noWallet: Connect a wallet to vote. Reading this ballot needs no wallet.
vote.notMember: This wallet is not on the roster, so it cannot vote here. Give your address to an officer to be added.

notOpen.pending: Voting has not opened yet. It opens {when}.
notOpen.over: Voting on this ballot has ended.

receipt.title: Your vote is recorded
receipt.body: You voted {option}. It was recorded in block {block}.
receipt.hashHelp: Receipt code: made from this ballot, your address, your choice and the block. Keep it to check your vote later.

finalise.title: Count the votes
finalise.body: Voting has ended. Anyone may publish the result; it is worked out from the votes already on the ledger.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this ballot
withdraw.body: An officer can withdraw a ballot until voting opens. After that it cannot be withdrawn.

verify.title: Check the count yourself
verify.body: Read every vote for this ballot from the ledger's event log, add them up in your browser, and compare with the number the contract published.
verify.mismatch: The recount does not match the contract.
verify.found: {count} votes found in the log, in blocks {first} to {last}.
verify.oddities: The log held a repeated voter or an option that does not exist, which this contract never allows. The log may belong to a different contract.
verify.error: Could not read the log. The network may be busy; try again.

tx.title: Transaction
tx.wallet: Waiting for you to approve it in your wallet.
tx.pending: Sent. Waiting for the network to put it in a block.
tx.failedInBlock: It reached block {block} but was refused.
tx.free: Nothing: this network does not charge for gas.

what.vote: Your vote is now part of the ledger. Nobody can change it or remove it.
what.finalise: The result is now published on the ledger.
what.withdraw: The ballot is withdrawn and cannot be voted on.
what.create: The ballot now exists on the ledger. Voting opens in a moment.
what.enrol: The member is now on the roster.
what.suspend: The member is suspended. They keep their past votes but cannot vote on new ballots.

errors.walletRejected: You declined it in your wallet. Nothing was sent.
errors.rateLimited: This address has sent too many requests for a moment. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.methodRefused: The public network address does not allow that request.
errors.noFunds: This wallet has no funds to pay the network fee. On a network that charges for gas, add some first.
errors.nonce: Your wallet's transaction count is out of step. Wait for pending transactions to finish, or reset the account in your wallet.
errors.pending: A transaction from this wallet is still waiting. Let it finish first.
errors.wrongNetwork: Your wallet is on a different network. Switch it to the network shown at the top of the page.
errors.reverted: The network refused it, and gave no reason. Check the ballot is still open and your wallet is on the roster.
errors.unreachable: The network did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. The details below may help an officer find out what.
errors.AlreadyVoted: You have already voted on ballot {ballot}. A vote can only be cast once.
errors.NotAMember: This wallet is not on the roster, so it cannot vote. Give your address to an officer.

VotingNotOpen.pending: Voting on ballot {ballot} has not opened yet.

errors.UnknownOption: That option is not on this ballot.
errors.VotingStillOpen: Voting has not ended yet, so the votes cannot be counted.
errors.AlreadyFinalised: This ballot has already been counted.
errors.CannotCancelNow: A ballot can only be withdrawn before voting opens.
errors.NoReceipt: This wallet has not voted on that ballot.
errors.WindowInPast: The closing time has already passed. Choose a later one.
errors.WindowInverted: The ballot cannot close before it opens.
errors.BadOptionCount: A ballot needs between {min} and {max} options. You gave {given}.
errors.QuorumTooHigh: The quorum cannot be more than 100 percent.
errors.NoElectorate: Add at least one member to the roster before opening a ballot.
errors.AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount: This wallet does not hold the role that action needs.
errors.AccessControlBadConfirmation: That role change was not confirmed by the right wallet.
errors.AlreadyEnrolled: That wallet is already on the roster.
errors.IdentifierAlreadyUsed: That registration number is already linked to another wallet.
errors.NotEnrolled: That wallet is not on the roster.
errors.LengthMismatch: The two lists have different lengths.

wallet.title: Your wallet
wallet.intro: Every ballot can be read without a wallet. You only need one to vote or to act as an officer.

via.local: A wallet kept in this browser.
via.node: A development account on the local node.

role.notMember: Not on the roster: can read, cannot vote.

app.title: Use a wallet app
app.body: MetaMask or any wallet that works in this browser. On a phone, open this page from inside your wallet app.
app.none: No wallet app was found in this browser.

local.title: Use a wallet on this device
local.body: For members with no wallet app. Sabha makes a wallet, locks it with a passphrase you choose and keeps it in this browser.
local.createBody: Choose a passphrase. Nobody can reset it for you, and without it the wallet cannot be opened.
local.tooSimple: Use more than one repeated character.
local.backupWarning: Download the backup file now. If this browser's data is cleared, the file and your passphrase are the only way back in. Keep the file somewhere safe.
local.addressHelp: Give this address to an officer so they can add you to the roster.
local.wrong: That passphrase did not open the wallet.
local.fileHelp: The file you downloaded when you created the wallet.
local.badFile: That is not a wallet backup file.
local.forget: Remove this wallet from the browser
local.forgetWarning: This removes the wallet from this browser. You can only get it back from the backup file.

node.title: Use a development account
node.body: This is a local test node with accounts already unlocked.

mine.title: Your votes
mine.lede: The ballots you have voted on, read from the ledger.
mine.error: Your votes could not be read just now.

noWallet.title: Connect a wallet to see your votes
noWallet.body: Votes belong to an address, so the page needs to know which wallet is yours.

empty.title: You have not voted yet
empty.body: When you vote, your receipt appears here.

officer.title: Officer desk
officer.lede: Open ballots and keep the roster. The contracts decide who may do what; this page only offers what your wallet is allowed.

noWallet.title: Connect a wallet to continue
noWallet.body: Officer tasks are tied to a wallet that holds a role.

noAccess.title: This wallet is not an officer
noAccess.body: Officers can open ballots and keep the roster. Ask the society's secretary to grant this address a role.

noProposer.title: This wallet cannot open ballots
noProposer.body: It can keep the roster. Opening a ballot needs the proposer role.

ballot.question: Question
ballot.backgroundHelp: Optional. Members read this before they vote.
ballot.optionsHelp_one: {count} option so far. A ballot needs between 2 and 16.
ballot.optionsHelp_other: {count} options so far. A ballot needs between 2 and 16.
ballot.durationHelp: Voting opens about {delay} seconds after it is recorded.
ballot.quorumHelp: There are {electorate} active members now. That number is fixed when the ballot is created.
ballot.quorumHelpPlain: The share of members that must vote for the result to count.
ballot.needOptions: Give between 2 and 16 options, one per line.
ballot.needHours: Choose a duration of at least 1 hour.
ballot.needQuorum: Quorum must be a number from 0 to 100.

roster.title: Members

empty.title: No members yet
empty.body: Add the first member below. A ballot cannot open until the roster has someone on it.

roster.errorBody: The network did not answer. Try again in a moment.
roster.identifierHelp: Only a fingerprint of this reaches the chain. The number itself stays in the society's own register.
roster.needAddress: Enter a wallet address: 0x followed by 40 characters.

network.title: Network
network.lede: The ledger underneath the ballots, and the machines that keep it.

error.title: Could not read the network
error.body: {network} did not answer. Try again in a moment.

network.feesFree: None. Members never need to hold any currency.
network.idleNote: When nobody is voting this network pauses between blocks, so a long gap is normal. A vote is included within a few seconds.
network.notQbft: This network does not use QBFT consensus, so there is no validator list to show.

validators.title: Validators
validators.body: These {count} nodes take turns proposing blocks, and a block needs agreement from more than two thirds of them before it counts.
